name: Itau Unibanco BRL Stablecoin
oneLiner: BRL-ITAU is a pre-launch stablecoin under evaluation by Brazil's largest private bank Itau Unibanco, with peg currency and design pending BCB regulation.
collateral: Pre-launch: Itau is evaluating a BRL- or USD-denominated stablecoin pending Brazil's Consulta Publica 111 framework. The bank already participates in the DREX wholesale CBDC pilot and would source distribution rails and custody from its existing regulated infrastructure, but no reserve composition has been publicly committed.
pegMechanism: Pre-launch: peg maintenance is not yet defined; launch is contingent on the final shape of BCB Consulta Publica 111, including self-custody rules and bank-issuer permissions. Itau is expected to use direct bank-issuer mint/redeem rails consistent with its existing custodial and FX infrastructure.

jurisdiction.regulator: Banco Central do Brasil (Resolutions 519/520/521 in force since February 2 2026)

launchPhaseDetail: Itau Unibanco (Brazil's largest private bank by assets, ~5.6T BRL) is evaluating its own stablecoin. Head of Digital Assets Guto Antunes confirmed exploration at an industry event in Sao Paulo in April 2025: 'we are always open to understanding whether it makes sense for our clients to have a stablecoin, even one in real, within Itau'. Brazil's virtual-asset framework (Consultas Publicas 109-111) was finalised as BCB Resolutions 519, 520, and 521 in November 2025 and took effect on February 2 2026; peg-currency choice (BRL or USD) and product timeline remain undisclosed. Itau already participates in the DREX wholesale CBDC pilot, providing distribution-rail experience; ticker not yet announced. Pharos tracks BRL as the most likely first launch given the Brazilian retail base, but the editorial summary documents the open USD option. In May 2026, BCB Resolution 561 (effective Oct 1 2026) banned authorised FX providers from using stablecoins or crypto to settle cross-border remittances, tightening the regulatory backdrop. At Blockchain.RIO on August 13 2026 Antunes said stablecoins and tokenised deposits must coexist, without committing to an Itau-issued token. No source has given a launch timeline since the April 2025 remark, so Pharos removed the 2026 expectation on September 13 2026.

milestones.title: Brazil stablecoin FX-classification regime takes effect
milestones.description: BCB resolutions classifying stablecoin transactions as foreign-exchange operations enter force; Itau's launch timing remains contingent on the final Consulta Publica 111 framework, especially around self-custody and bank-issuer permissions.

milestones.title: BCB Resolution 561 bans stablecoin settlement in regulated cross-border FX
milestones.description: Brazil's central bank publishes Resolution 561 (effective Oct 1 2026) prohibiting authorised FX providers from using stablecoins or crypto to settle cross-border remittances, a restrictive backdrop for any BRL stablecoin, though it does not name Itau.
